title: Paul Thigpen's path from the woo to Catholicism

tellings.quote: he uh he encountered this stuff, the woo and everything else. And uh the woo led him to search for truth. He found his way into Catholicism.

plain: A man named Paul Thigpen ran into what people call "the woo", strange paranormal experiences, and that pushed him to search for the truth, a search that ended with him becoming Catholic. A guest named Dylan Borland passes this on as Thigpen's own story, as an example of how such encounters can lead a person toward religion.
